verdict.rationale: A tax agency with system-to-system channels such as EFILE could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. EFILE is a certification-gated channel for tax software, not a published spec, and the llms.txt probe returned a soft 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
